FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 336
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Senator Clyde Chambliss
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 04/30/2025
Senate Bill 336 as introduced would authorize certain local boards of education to convert two
or more non-charter public schools into conversion public charter school districts under the
authority of the local board of education. This bill could increase the obligations of a local board
of education that decide to convert multiple schools into a conversion public charter school
district, by an undetermined amount dependent upon the costs associated with creating a
separate conversion public charter school district pursuant to the provisions of this bill.
